from chb_prd_baseinfo info left join ( select prod_id, prod_yield, change_date from ( select rank() over(partition by prod_id order by change_date desc) my_rank,prod_id, prod_yield, change_date from chb_prd_rate where change_date <= #{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} ) where my_rank = 1 ) cpr on nvl (info.fprod_id,info.prod_id)=cpr.prod_id left join (/***期末净值*/ select prod_id,ccy,prod_value,CHANGE_DATE,UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL,TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM from ( select rank() over(partition by prod_id order by change_date desc) my_rank,prod_id,ccy,prod_value,CHANGE_DATE,UNIT_VALUE_TOTAL,TDY_UNIT_VALUE_SUM from CHB_PRD_PERIODYIELD where CHANGE_DATE =#{enddate,jdbcType=DATE} and CHANG_TYPE='01' AND STATUS IN ('E','M') ) where my_rank=1 )val on nvl (info.fprod_id,info.prod_id)=val.prod_id

'03' then HIGH_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '04' then LOW_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when
